answer_4.quote: To obtain this upper bound estimation, we asked three human annotators to read the complete conversation history of two movie characters (the same as the input given to the model) and identify the applicable relationships.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators were supposed to indicate all the relationships applicable to the pair of characters, pertaining to the given rules. Pay attention that the relationships are directed, mark the relation only from A to B. Inspect relationships in all 3 categories and select all that apply, at least one relationship in this HIT should be selected.
